## Goal
- Execute the owner's new "ACTIVATE IVX 12-IA OPERATING MODEL" mandate: stand up 12 persistent IA agents (IA-01…IA-12) with task queue, file locks, AI Factory, acquisition/CRM pipelines on real data, 24/7 operation surviving restarts, and post the first live 18-field operational report to IVX AI Chat — prior FINAL PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT already delivered as VERIFIED (server-side scope).

## Constraints & Preferences
- No IA claimed active without execution logs; no fake/placeholder leads; no fabricated counts — all numbers from live Supabase rows
- One permanent owner per task; no two agents edit same critical file simultaneously; QA approval before merge; deployment evidence before VERIFIED
- Cadence: health 5m, auth 15m, acquisition/CRM continuous, consolidated owner-chat report every 2h; P0/P1 escalated immediately; state must survive Render restart
- IA-11 read-only/recommendation mode only; no money movement ever without owner approval + 2FA; IA-09 no unauthorized scraping/spam; owner approval mandatory for prod deploys, money, legal, permission escalation
- New agents (IA-02 output) require IA-03 QA pass + owner approval before activation
- 2-hour report must include 18 mandated fields (timestamp, active IAs, tasks assigned/completed/verified, GitHub SHA, Render deploy, new investors/buyers/tokenized, qualified leads, outreach sent, responses, new IAs created, tests pass/fail, blockers, P0/P1, next 2h actions)
- Do not interrupt current IVX production app; keep production stable; fix P0/P1 first
- Never mark VERIFIED without evidence; don't ask for credentials unless runtime proves missing/expired/401/403
- Guarded pipeline: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` `{action:"github_commit_file", confirm:true, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE", reason, input:{path,content,message,branch}}`; Cloudflare WAF blocks ≥~100–200KB (never re-commit backend/hono.ts 306KB — register routes in backend/hono-extended.ts)
- Management API SQL: `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query` `{"query":"..."}` → 201; multi-statement + DO $$ ok; ~55s timeout; token `/tmp/sbp_token`
- Owner token (~15 min TTL): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; longer session via admin generate_link + `/auth/v1/verify` (saved `/tmp/owner_at`)

## Progress
### Done

- Incident loop VERIFIED with real incident: INC-0001 auto-opened 23:17:56Z (api_health during deploy), retest 4/4 pass 23:20:00Z, auto-closed, reports in owner chat
- Smoke test: landing/www/health 200; owner routes 401 unauth / 200 with bearer; `/api/ivx/autonomous/jobs` = 404 (route doesn't exist; ledger is `/ledger`)
- Secret scan CLEAN: no sbp_/service-role in repo; JWT hits are public anon key + test fixtures (expo/shared/ivx/access-control.ts, backend/*.test.ts, expo/mocks/developer-handoff.ts); credentials endpoint masks values

- **12-IA tables created in Supabase** (HTTP 201): `ivx_ia_agents`, `ivx_ia_tasks`, `ivx_ia_file_locks`, `ivx_ia_factory_agents` — all RLS-enabled with service_role policies
- **Seeded**: 12 agents (IA-01…IA-12 with missions/permissions/KPIs), 14 tasks (IAT-0001…IAT-0014), 2 factory rows: TPL-0001 (IVX IA Agent Template, PASSED/TEMPLATE) + PIA-0001 (Personal Investment Assistant IA v1, UNTESTED/PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL) — confirmed `{agents:12, tasks:14, factory_rows:2}`
- **Written locally**: `backend/api/ivx-ia-orchestrator.ts` (marker `ivx-ia-orchestrator-2026-07-18`) — GET `/api/ivx/autonomous/ia`, POST `/ia/task`, POST `/ia/lock` (409 on conflict, 30min TTL); exports `getIAOperatingSummary()` + `getAcquisitionCounts()` for 2h report

### In Progress
- Wire orchestrator routes into `backend/hono-extended.ts` + add `getIAOperatingSummary()` lines to scheduler's 2h chat report; then commit via guarded pipeline and deploy

### Blocked
- Email delivery: needs custom SMTP in Supabase Auth (owner dashboard action) — JOB-0005
- Token `sbp_f5ad980bd19f4edd6014a787433e00bdb8267454` exposed in chat, still active — owner must rotate at supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens then update `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` on Render (APR-006)
- Physical Android/iPhone device QA + fresh APK delivery URL (7-day URL expired; needs new build run) — JOB-0010
- GitHub token lacks `workflow` scope (APR-004); service-role rotation (APR-001); release keystore (APR-003) — owner actions

## Key Decisions
- 12-IA state persisted in Supabase tables (not durable-store files) so it survives restarts and is queryable; agent template + created agents live in `ivx_ia_factory_agents` with QA/activation gates
- PIA-0001 stays PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL until IA-03 QA (IAT-0004) + owner approval — no auto-activation
- Acquisition counts computed via PostgREST `Prefer: count=exact` content-range (no row transfer); tokenized prospects = `investment_tier=ilike.*token*`
- Management API `database/query` remains the migration/DDL path; new routes only via hono-extended.ts (WAF size limit)
- QA chat reporter posts via ivx_messages REST insert (service-role, sender_label 'IVX Autonomous QA (W6/W9)', room `ivx-owner-room`)
- Local shell lacks RENDER_API_KEY/GITHUB_TOKEN — use production endpoints for deploy/repo facts
- `bunx tsc --noEmit` full-repo has pre-existing errors — grep-filter for touched files only

3. CRM pass (IAT-0011): dedupe/score investors honestly — data reality: 875 rows, only 5 unique emails, 871 missing email, 0 country data, 0 capital committed, 870 status=prospect, 1 tokenized-tier; record data-quality findings, don't fabricate qualification
4. IA-04/IA-05 app-from-scratch audit (IAT-0005/0006) with evidence; small proof app without touching production
5. IA-03 QA scenarios for PIA-0001 (IAT-0004): cross-tenant isolation, money-movement refusal, statement accuracy, auth required
6. Post first live 18-field operational report to IVX AI Chat (IAT-0014); update job ledger; complete pending todo items (todoWrite list active, item 1 in_progress)
